values.note: 37 campsites, no tent-only sites: 33 Campsite Electric and 4 Campsite on ReserveAmerica (24 in Loop A, 13 in Loop B). FWP's RV/trailer limit is 40 ft; RA's per-site max vehicle lengths run 18-45 ft, and A007 (20 ft) is the only pull-through. Also 12 day-use boat slips.

sites.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/logan ('There are 37 total campsites, and no tent-only sites. The RV/trailer size limit is 40 feet in length.') + audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json (ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 630114), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water and showers close in late September (Sept. 21 in 2025). The RV dump station closes at the beginning of October and since 2024 is only for registered Logan campers.

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/logan (Amenities: 'RV Dump Station', 'Shower', 'Toilets (Flush)', 'Water'; 'The RV dump station closes at the beginning of October'; 'Starting in 2024, the RV dump station will only be available to registered campers at Logan State Park'; 'Water and showers Closes Sept. 21, 2025'), read 2026-10-22

note: MT state park on the north shore of Middle Thompson Lake, ~45 mi SE of Libby on Hwy 2; heavily forested. 30 sites reservable via ReserveAmerica, 7 FCFS. --Claude
